snippet.title: Halloween Party 2020 | New Club Penguin
snippet.description:
Prepare for a spooky halloween with green goop, mysterious fog, and a ghosty breed of a puffle... Get your candy ready and put on your witch hats because the Halloween Party starts on the 23rd.

Log on now over at:
https://play.newcp.net

Check out what's new on New Club Penguin on our blog:
https://www.newcp.net/blog

Join our Discord Community:
https://discord.gg/clubpenguin
